dimensions.What it records: Retained facts, definitions, exemplars, vocabulary, chronology, canonical results.
dimensions.Observable standard: Can recall and recognize without aid where foundational.

dimensions.What it records: Ability to apply in unfamiliar domains/representations.
dimensions.Observable standard: Solves unseen variations without template matching.
Can perform reliably under realistic constraints.

dimensions.What it records: Selection among tradeoffs under uncertainty and conflicting values.
dimensions.Observable standard: Can defend criteria, update, and preserve uncertainty.

dimensions.What it records: Writing, speech, visual representation, listening, teaching.
dimensions.Observable standard: Adapts to audience and medium without corrupting content.

dimensions.What it records: Tool choice, delegation, evals, provenance, monitoring, fallback.
dimensions.Observable standard: Can improve outcomes with AI while retaining ownership and safety.

dimensions.What it records: Evidence from measurement, users, field, operations, primary sources, or physical artifacts.
dimensions.Observable standard: Can identify where model meets territory and where it fails.

dimensions.What it records: Stakeholder, rights, safety, legitimacy, professional duty, recourse.
dimensions.Observable standard: Can identify responsibility and act proportionately.

dimensions.What it records: Can diagnose gaps, design practice, seek feedback, retain and renew competence.
dimensions.Observable standard: Can teach self into a new domain.
Preserves option value and learning capacity.

levels.Name: Unformed
levels.Interpretation: Cannot yet perform or explain reliably; output may be copied or tool-dependent.

levels.Name: Exposed
levels.Interpretation: Recognizes vocabulary/examples and can follow a guided demonstration.

levels.Name: Functional
levels.Interpretation: Performs standard cases with limited support and can explain the main model.

levels.Name: Independent
levels.Interpretation: Handles unseen transfer, errors, tradeoffs, and defense with appropriate tools.

levels.Name: Generative / Steward
levels.Interpretation: Can teach, design new approaches, identify limits, improve systems, and remain reliable under perturbation.
